task.title: To connect to Apttus Omni from X-Author Designer

step.cmd: In the X-Author Designer or X-Author for Excel ribbon menu, click Connect.

info.p: If this is the first time you have connected to your environment, the Manage Connections window opens.

step.cmd: Under the Create a new connection section, in the first field, enter a name for your connection.

note.p:
If you have previously connected to your environment, but need to connect to a different instance, refer to
Switching Connections
.

step.cmd: In the second field, enter the URL you use to log in to your environment.
Click Authorize. The Microsoft login window opens.

note.p: If you have previously connected to Microsoft Dynamics CRM, you will see the last user information by default. To log in to your Apttus Omni instance, click "+ Use another account" to log in.

step.cmd: Enter your username and password in the provided fields and click Sign in.

postreq.p: The X-Author Designer ribbon is fully enabled. Now you can start, designing an app or using existing apps.
